principles: Focused validation is an explicit development aid, not a replacement for full validation.
Timeout changes must preserve bounded execution and failure attribution.
Baseline result artifacts are derived records; the immutable baseline is not rewritten.
Do not optimize arbitrary paths outside validateCostAndTimeoutRisk.
drivers: B-4bd7 baseline requires a measurable after comparison for item 1.
Full validation and DONE-required validation must remain strong gates.
The change should reduce false timeout pressure without hiding hung commands.

options.name: Make default validate focused
cons: Risks treating focused output as final proof

options.name: Add explicit focus profile and keep full default
pros: Gives development and review a clear fast path
cons: Requires a new CLI/config surface and smoke coverage

options.name: Only raise timeout
cons: Does not fix the missing focused/full workflow distinction from the baseline

chosen: Add explicit focus profile and keep full default
rationale: This is the narrowest correction that addresses the real workflow issue without weakening full validation or DONE-required gates.

preMortem.scenario: Focused mode is later mistaken for DONE proof
preMortem.trigger: Output does not clearly identify focused validation
preMortem.consequence: A story may stop after a subset and overclaim completion
preMortem.mitigation: Focused result provider/summary must say focused and the smoke must assert default validate remains full.

preMortem.scenario: Timeout is raised into effectively unbounded execution
preMortem.trigger: Default exceeds the global watchdog or removes per-command timeout attribution
preMortem.consequence: Hung validation blocks the CLI and no test evidence is written
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the default bounded below a known ceiling or explicitly assert bounded behavior and explicit timeout override.

preMortem.scenario: Scope creep into unrelated efficiency items
preMortem.trigger: Touching delivery, summary, proof metadata, or Codex adapter files in this story
preMortem.consequence: Baseline item attribution becomes muddy and review becomes harder
preMortem.mitigation: Scope contract excludes those areas; later items get their own stories.
